# Fabneon Technologies Limited

> Premier Enterprise Software Engineering, SaaS Products, and Digital Transformation Agency in Bangladesh.

Fabneon Technologies Limited (commonly known as Fabneon) is a registered corporate technology firm in Bangladesh. The company specializes in building high-scale enterprise software, custom ERP platforms, hardware-diagnostic operating systems, and accredited educational technology ecosystems for global clients across 40+ countries.

## Flagship Products & Case Studies

### 1. RepairSoft (GKTool)
- **URL**: https://repairsoft.fabneon.com
- **Category**: Electronics Repair Workshop & Diagnostics Operating System
- **Problems Solved**: Eliminated misplaced device inventory, untracked component-level micro-soldering job sheets, and manual customer updates for electronics and smartphone repair centers.
- **Key Features**: Multi-stage job sheet ticketing, component-level barcode inventory (SMD ICs, screens, flex cables), automated WhatsApp customer status alerts, technician commission analytics, and point-of-sale billing.

### 2. Global Knowledge Institute (GKITI) Ecosystem
- **Client**: Global Knowledge (GKITI) — Bangladesh's premier government-accredited mobile repair and hardware diagnostic training academy under the Bangladesh Technical Education Board (BTEB Code: 23415). Verified on Bangladesh Govt. BTEB Registry: https://btebcbt.gov.bd/utility/showInstitute/614 (Accredited under CBT&A NTVQF for Mobile Phone Servicing).
- **Problems Solved**: Overcame pen-and-paper enrollment bottlenecks across 64 districts, solved lecture video piracy, automated counterfeit-proof certificate verification, and integrated lab biometric attendance.
- **Key Features**: Student and alumni portal, proprietary anti-piracy DRM video player with dynamic student watermarking, automated BTEB-accredited digital certificate generation with instant QR verification, and admissions automation.

### 3. FabPharma
- **Category**: Enterprise Pharmacy & Healthcare Retail ERP
- **Problems Solved**: Prevented pharmaceutical dead-stock due to unmonitored drug expirations, streamlined high-speed multi-counter retail checkout, and automated wholesale restocking.
- **Key Features**: Batch-level expiry tracking with 90/60/30-day proactive alerts, generic drug substitution finder, integrated barcode POS, wholesale procurement ledgers, and digital prescription archiving.

### 4. Centraio Cloud OS
- **Category**: Multi-Tenant Higher-Ed Campus Operating System & University ERP SaaS
- **Problems Solved**: Overcame fragmented spreadsheet silos, delayed semester tuition collection, manual student transcript calculation, and disconnected department records across academic institutions.
- **Key Features**: Dynamic subdomain multi-tenancy, automated recurring tuition billing and late-fee ledgers, biometric and RFID student/staff attendance pipelines, and automated CGPA exam tabulation supporting BTEB and UGC standards.

### 5. Madrasah Management System (MMS)
- **Category**: Specialized Residential Islamic Academy ERP & Hifz Progress Platform
- **Problems Solved**: Replaced paper-based Quran memorization diaries with institutional radar, stopped dining hall food wastage with residential mess quota management, and unified monthly waqf and student fee collection.
- **Key Features**: 30-Para granular Hifz memorization engine (Sabaq, Sabqi, Manzil), residential hostel boarding management, automated fee receipts with thermal ESC/POS printing, and instant bilingual (English/Bengali) SMS alerts to parents.

### 6. iTrust E-Commerce Platform
- **URL**: https://itrust.com.bd
- **Client**: iTrust Online Store — Consumer Retail
- **Category**: High-Conversion E-Commerce & Retail Platform
- **Problems Solved**: Fixed mobile checkout drop-offs and production order creation 500 errors, restored collapsed advertising ROAS by implementing full-funnel server-side Meta Conversions API (CAPI), and automated delivery pricing across Bangladesh.
- **Key Features**: Sub-second edge-rendered Nuxt 3 mobile storefront, dynamic 64-district and 500+ thana courier shipping matrix, dual-layer client+server Meta CAPI tracking for 100% purchase attribution, and streamlined 2-click checkout.
